subject.title: feat(memory-wiki): add wiki_open_items tool to list unresolved questions and contradictions

question: Should memory-wiki permanently expose `wiki_open_items` as a dedicated agent tool instead of enriching `wiki_lint` or another existing query surface?
rationale: The capability fills a demonstrated structured-data gap, but choosing another model-facing tool and response contract requires product and API ownership judgment.

options.title: Add Dedicated Tool
options.body: Accept `wiki_open_items` as the focused read-only enumeration contract after removing the private-export baseline additions.

options.title: Extend Wiki Lint
options.body: Keep the tool set smaller by adding item text, filters, and contradiction variants to the existing `wiki_lint` response.

options.title: Defer The Primitive
options.body: Wait until the broader interactive resolution workflow defines the exact enumeration and write-back contract it requires.

recommendation.title: Add Dedicated Tool
recommendation.body: Accept `wiki_open_items` as the focused read-only enumeration contract after removing the private-export baseline additions.

likelyOwner.reason: The original memory-wiki tool, dashboard, and claim-health history most directly matches this API-direction decision.
